title: hydrangea aspera var. robusta
intro: Hydrangea aspera var. robusta, commonly known as 'Robust Mountain Hydrangea', is a deciduous shrub native to the mountainous regions of China. This plant has been traditionally used in herbal medicine for its various health benefits, which include reducing fever, inflammation, and relieving pain. The therapeutic actions of Hydrangea aspera var. robusta include its anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and analgesic properties, which can help soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
